reference.name: Vase Maker
reference.author: Dante x
reference.access: Read-only inspection of the user-installed package; no full plugin import or registration.

folded_petals_example.note: Counts from the reviewed pure estimator only. They are not a runtime benchmark or a validation of the reference mesh.

source_reuse: Curled ribbon midpoint/offset construction adapted into ribbon_geometry.py with the original copyright and full MIT permission notice. Complete reference plugin and reference screenshots are not redistributed.
gaps: Reference leaf/crater controls include valley depth, stagger, cell aspect and sharpness, which the current geometric layer does not expose.
Reference spiral bloom uses one family of rounded helical blades, unlike the current two-wave relief.
Reference ripple varies angular phase vertically, unlike the current horizontal rings.
scope: Source comparison only; no native OrcaSlicer interaction, plugin installation, merge or release.

ribbon_implementation.status: Implemented after user selected actual curled ribbons
ribbon_implementation.construction: Independent closed cup and ribbon shells; intentional overlaps, no Boolean-union claim
ribbon_implementation.height_fix: Normal-offset vertices are trimmed to Z=0..requested height
